excluded_from_commit.policy: Business evidence and execution artifacts under data/reports remain local and untracked; they were not deleted.

absolute_difference.cause: The local monetary comparison contract only exposed signed 'difference' and 'percent'; there was no absolute-difference mode, so a question asking for a magnitude was answered with the signed subtraction without separating magnitude from direction.
fix: Added mode 'absolute_difference' for period and component comparisons next to 'difference', 'percent' and 'ratio_percent'.
Audit keeps difference (signed), absolute_difference (magnitude), direction (target_higher/baseline_higher/equal), reported (signed/absolute) and value (delivered figure).
Response text states magnitude and direction of change separately.
Interpreter guidance selects the mode from the question and forbids conflating participation with variation or signed with absolute difference.
Unknown modes are rejected with ambiguous_comparison instead of silently degrading to a signed subtraction.
